load_lightning_checkpoint: load a Fast3R model from a Lightning checkpoint directory onto a specified device
load_model: load a Fast3R model from a Lightning or HuggingFace checkpoint onto a device
convert_checkpoint_to_hf_checkpoint: convert a Lightning checkpoint to HuggingFace format and optionally push to the Hub
review_load_lightning_checkpoint: review the load_lightning_checkpoint function to understand DeepSpeed checkpoint conversion logic
refactor_load_model: refactor the load_model function to support additional checkpoint formats beyond Lightning and HuggingFace
